extracted.intended_audience: general public and amateur comedians who read or submit jokes to Laugh Factory
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and site signals relevant to reading, classifying, and submitting short jokes, photos, or videos to the Laugh Factory website and becoming a site member. Includes content categories, voting/share mechanics, and submission/account notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit a Joke / content submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit your best content, jokes, photos, or videos to become an exclusive Laugh Factory member and have your content shared on our website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invitation to submit material; implies submissions should be the author's best work and may include text jokes, photos, or videos. No explicit length, style, or content restrictions are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content types allowed
rubrics_metrics.description: The site accepts jokes, photos, and videos for submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page explicitly lists these permitted content formats when inviting contributors; use these formats to be considered for membership and sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joke categories / genre labels
rubrics_metrics.description: Jokes are organized into topical/tonal categories such as Latest Jokes, Popular Jokes, Joke of the Day, Animal Jokes, Blonde Jokes, Boycott These Jokes, Clean Jokes, Family Jokes, Food Jokes, Holiday Jokes, Insult Jokes, Miscellaneous Jokes, Office Jokes, Political Jokes, Pop Culture Jokes, Relationship Jokes, Religious Jokes, School Jokes, Science Jokes, Sex Jokes, Sports Jokes, Technology Jokes, Wordplay Jokes, Yo Momma Jokes, and Jokes from you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the category that best fits your material; categories imply differences in tone and audience acceptability (e.g., Clean vs Insult/Sex/Religious). The presence of a 'Jokes from you' category indicates a user-submission channel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience engagement metric (Laughs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each joke displays a 'Laughs' count (e.g., '0 Laughs') as a visible popularity/engagement metric.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This visible vote count is used to gauge audience reaction/popularity. Sharing and promotion may increase this metric; the page shows social sharing options beside jokes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social sharing and attribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Jokes include 'Share' buttons for Facebook and Twitter and display an author/handle (e.g., @TheLaughFactory, @trevorwallace).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions and published jokes are expected to be shareable on social platforms and show attribution handles; authorship attribution is part of how content is presented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account login / Facebook connect permissions
rubrics_metrics.description: When logging in or connecting with Facebook, the site will access and use your email address, friend list, interests, likes and public profile, including name, profile picture, user ID, age range, gender, networks, language, country and other public info.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creating an account via Facebook requires consenting to data access described; the site asserts it will not post to Facebook without permission. This is a prerequisite for some member/submission features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership benefit (exclusive Laugh Factory member)
rubrics_metrics.description: Becoming an exclusive Laugh Factory member may result in having your content shared on the website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The invitation implies a selection/approval process for member status and that accepted members receive promotional sharing; no explicit criteria for selection are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright and reproduction restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: The website is protected by U.S. and International copyright laws. Reproduction and distribution of content, with or without modification, without written permission of Laugh Factory Inc. is prohibited. Laugh Factory, LaughFactory.com, the Laugh Factory logo, and all media posted have proprietary rights and are registered as trademarks and copyrights of Laugh Factory Inc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributors and readers must respect ownership and obtain written permission before reproducing site content; posting/submitting content does not imply permission to freely republish elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cookie use / personalization
rubrics_metrics.description: The site uses cookies to enhance browsing experience, serve personalized content, and analyze traffic. By clicking 'Accept All' users consent to cookies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personalization and analytics are enabled via cookies; users can accept or decline. This affects how content may be presented to readers and contributors.
